root_cause.text: The vulnerability stems from the DAT inode's btree node cache (`i_assoc_inode`) being initialized lazily during btree operations rather than at mount time, causing a NULL pointer dereference in `nilfs_mdt_save_to_shadow_map` when garbage collection is invoked before any btree operation has occurred.
root_cause.evidence: The CVE description states that `i_assoc_inode` is initialized lazily while `nilfs_mdt_save_to_shadow_map()` assumes it is already initialized, noting that calling `NILFS_IOCTL_CLEAN_SEGMENTS` immediately after mount leads to a general protection fault due to the NULL value; the patch resolves this by adding an explicit call to `nilfs_attach_btree_node_cache(dat)` within `nilfs_dat_read()` to ensure initialization occurs at mount time.
